expected_issues.description:
New `visitRatio` is now part of the abstract API and is used downstream to compute buffer sizes (e.g., `visitRatio * numCentroids * ...` then cast to int). To avoid NaN/Inf/negative values propagating into sizing/casts (which can lead to 0, negative, or overflowed sizes and runtime exceptions), consider validating/clamping `visitRatio` in `IVFVectorsReader.search` before passing it to `getCentroidIterator` (e.g., ensure finite and within [0..1]).

```suggestion
            postListSlice,
            Float.isFinite(visitRatio) ? Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, visitRatio)) : 0f
```
